description: This PHP class 'PIMLeftMenuService' manages the generation, caching, and permission validation of the left navigation menu for the PIM (Personal Information Management) module of the OrangeHRM system. It handles permissions based on user roles, employee states, and configuration settings, providing menu items based on user context and access rights.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing the PIM left menu, including generating menu items based on user permissions, caching, and handling employee-specific menu data.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeService instance used within this class.

methods.name: setEmployeeService
methods.description: Sets the employee service instance used by this class.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Returns the menu items for a given employee, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: clearCachedMenu
methods.description: Clears the cached menu from the user's session data for a specific employee or all employees if null.

methods.name: isPimAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the PIM menu is accessible for a specific employee.

methods.name: generateMenuItems
methods.description: Generates the menu items based on user role permissions and employee state.

methods.name: isEmployeeWorkflowActionsAllowed
methods.description: Determines whether actions such as terminate or reactive are allowed for a specific employee based on their current workflow state.

methods.name: getMenuFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves the employee menu from session cache.

methods.name: saveMenuInCache
methods.description: Stores the generated menu in session cache.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Returns the list of actions that are available to the current user, considering feature toggles like tax menu.

methods.name: isTaxMenuEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the tax exemptions menu is enabled based on configuration and caches the result.

methods.name: getPreparedMenuItems
methods.description: Prepares and formats the menu items with URLs and active state for rendering in the UI.
